subject: Annual Goals and Subcommittee Structure
overview: The MPS Behavioral Health & Special Education Subcommittee met to set its annual goals and establish a new meeting structure for the school year. The subcommittee decided to alternate monthly meetings between special education and behavioral health focus areas.

items.title: Subcommittee Meeting Format and Structure
items.summary: Joan Bowen and Stacey Schulman proposed alternating monthly subcommittee meetings between special education and behavioral health topics to allow more focused progress between sessions.

items.title: Special Education Annual Goals
items.summary: The committee discussed special education goals focused on expanding inclusive recreation partnerships and establishing guidance on supportive disability language.

items.title: Behavioral Health Annual Goals
items.summary: Members discussed behavioral health priorities, focusing on family mental health outreach, clarifying counseling roles, and identifying local mental health provider resources.

items.title: 2021–2022 Meeting Schedule
items.summary: Melanie McLaughlin announced the schedule of subcommittee meeting dates through June 2022, leading to planned policy recommendations for the full school committee in May.
